declarations.name: PrimeOrSemiprime
declarations.type: (m : Nat) -> Prop
declarations.meaning: Prime m or existence of primes r,q with m=r*q; multiplicity allowed, receiver 1 excluded.

declarations.name: ImbalancedReceiver
declarations.type: (num den m : Nat) -> Prop
declarations.meaning: Prime m or prime r,q with m=r*q and r^den <= q^num; no factor ordering.

declarations.name: BadReceiver
declarations.type: (num den m : Nat) -> Prop
declarations.meaning: PrimeOrSemiprime m and not ImbalancedReceiver num den m.

declarations.name: ImbalancedReceiver.primeOrSemiprime
declarations.type: {num den m : Nat} -> ImbalancedReceiver num den m -> PrimeOrSemiprime m

declarations.name: imbalancedReceiver_of_factors
declarations.type: {num den m r q : Nat} -> Prime r -> Prime q -> m=r*q -> r^den <= q^num -> ImbalancedReceiver num den m

declarations.name: badReceiver_iff
declarations.type: {num den m : Nat} -> BadReceiver num den m <-> (not Prime m) and (exists prime factors r,q, m=r*q) and (forall prime factors r,q with m=r*q, q^num < r^den)
declarations.proof: Both directions by disjunction/existential elimination and lt_of_not_ge / not_lt_of_ge; no factorization uniqueness assumption.

declarations.name: chenPrimes
declarations.type: (N : Nat) -> Finset Nat
declarations.meaning: Filter range N by Prime p and PrimeOrSemiprime (N-p).

declarations.name: imbalancedPrimes
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> Finset Nat
declarations.meaning: Filter range N by Prime p and ImbalancedReceiver num den (N-p).

declarations.name: badPrimes
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> Finset Nat
declarations.meaning: Filter range N by Prime p and BadReceiver num den (N-p).

declarations.name: D12
declarations.type: (N : Nat) -> Nat

declarations.name: Db
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> Nat

declarations.name: B
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> Nat

declarations.name: mem_chenPrimes
declarations.type: {N p : Nat} -> p in chenPrimes N <-> p<N and Prime p and PrimeOrSemiprime (N-p)

declarations.name: mem_imbalancedPrimes
declarations.type: {num den N p : Nat} -> p in imbalancedPrimes num den N <-> p<N and Prime p and ImbalancedReceiver num den (N-p)

declarations.name: mem_badPrimes
declarations.type: {num den N p : Nat} -> p in badPrimes num den N <-> p<N and Prime p and PrimeOrSemiprime (N-p) and not ImbalancedReceiver num den (N-p)

declarations.name: imbalancedPrimes_subset_chenPrimes
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> imbalancedPrimes num den N subset chenPrimes N

declarations.name: badPrimes_subset_chenPrimes
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> badPrimes num den N subset chenPrimes N

declarations.name: imbalancedPrimes_disjoint_badPrimes
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> Disjoint (imbalancedPrimes num den N) (badPrimes num den N)

declarations.name: chenPrimes_eq_union
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> chenPrimes N = imbalancedPrimes num den N union badPrimes num den N
declarations.proof: Finset ext and classical by_cases on ImbalancedReceiver.

declarations.name: D12_eq_Db_add_B
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> D12 N = Db num den N + B num den N

declarations.name: Db_eq_D12_sub_B
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> Db num den N = D12 N - B num den N

declarations.name: B_le_D12
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> B num den N <= D12 N

declarations.name: Db_cast_eq_D12_sub_B
declarations.type: (num den N : Nat) -> (Db num den N : Real) = (D12 N : Real) - (B num den N : Real)

declarations.name: finite_transfer
declarations.type: {num den N : Nat} {lower upper : Real} -> lower <= (D12 N : Real) -> (B num den N : Real) <= upper -> lower-upper <= (Db num den N : Real)
declarations.proof: Rewrite cast subtraction, linarith. BOTH analytic bounds are explicit hypotheses.

declarations.name: exists_imbalanced_of_lower_gt_upper
declarations.type: {num den N : Nat} {lower upper : Real} -> lower <= (D12 N : Real) -> (B num den N : Real) <= upper -> upper<lower -> exists p : Nat, p<N and Prime p and ImbalancedReceiver num den (N-p)
declarations.proof: Transfer gives real card positive; exact_mod_cast to Nat; Finset.card_pos; membership.
